text:
The median asking rent in Chemnitz stands at 6.1 €/m², up 4.2 % year‑on‑year and 15.0 % over the past five years, placing the city at rank 37 of the 37 most expensive German markets. Asking rents are modestly above existing rents (5.26 €/m²), with a 16.0 % premium, and a 60 m² apartment costs about 366 € per month.

Market tightness is low: days on market average 61, only 8 % of listings are let within a week and vacancy sits at 9.4 %. The rent‑burden for two residents is 8.8 %, indicating relatively affordable conditions despite a slack balance.

The model estimate forecasts the median asking rent to reach 6.21 €/m² in 12 months, ranging between 6.07 €/m² and 6.41 €/m², a modest 1.7 % increase.
